description: DEV-2975 — READ-ONLY ADMIN DIAGNOSTIC (admin_work_email.delivery_check): did a sender’s mail reach an exact managed @opentrain.work address in a bounded window? Use it before asking a client to resend an external-platform invitation (Slack, etc.). Requires an EXACT managed address, a sender filter (fromDomain and/or fromAddress), since (window ≤ 14 days, start ≤ 30 days ago) and a single-line reason. Needs the work_email_delivery:read permission (never part of Full access); the server additionally requires an OpenTrain platform admin in the OpenTrain admin organization — everyone else gets 403. Delivery metadata only (sender domain, subject, received time, Inbox/Junk folder, provider ids) — never bodies, previews, attachments, display names or other recipients. Only received mail naming the exact address in To/Cc counts (drafts and sent copies never do). Verdicts: DELIVERED, DELIVERED_TO_JUNK, NOT_FOUND (every candidate scanned and not in the mailbox — the SMTP log is not read, so never proof the sender was refused), INCONCLUSIVE (no match before the 500-candidate scan cap; see coverage), MAILBOX_UNAVAILABLE, MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND; a provider outage is a retryable 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. Every check is audited with its reason before the result returns. structuredContent IS the raw closed response.
name: opentrain_admin_work_email_delivery_check
